questions.question: What is the primary safety rule when a customer approaches a forecourt pump while smoking a cigarette?

options.A: Ignore it as long as they are standing outside their vehicle.
options.B: Politely and immediately ask the customer to extinguish the cigarette before fuel dispensing begins.
options.C: Wait until fuel dispensing is complete before informing the manager.
options.D: Offer them a designated smoking area on the forecourt island.

questions.explanation: Naked flames on the forecourt pose an immediate fire hazard due to volatile fuel vapors. Staff must politely demand immediate extinguishment before fuel flow.

options.B: Escort them to the emergency wash basin immediately, flush affected skin with clean water for 15 minutes, and offer clean clothing.
options.C: Apply hand sanitizer to dilute the gasoline.

options.D: Allow the pump hose to stretch to its maximum length.

questions.explanation: Drive-offs cause mechanical stress and potential fuel line rupture. Emergency shutoff stops fuel pressurization while magnetic breakaways isolate the pump.

options.C: Fetch a mop and bucket from the storage room.
options.D: Call the fuel delivery tanker supplier.

questions.question: Why must water NEVER be used to wash away a gasoline spill on a forecourt floor?

options.A: Water increases fuel pressure inside underground tanks.
options.B: Gasoline floats on water, spreading flammable liquid over a wider area and generating volatile vapor.
options.C: Water turns gasoline into explosive gel.
options.D: It ruins the concrete seal sealant.

questions.explanation: Gasoline is lighter than water and insoluble. Adding water floats the fuel, expanding the fire hazard zone.

questions.question: Why must forecourt staff use a non-sparking plastic spade and hard-bristle broom (never a steel shovel) when cleaning a fuel spill?

options.B: Metal scraping on concrete forecourt paving creates friction sparks that can ignite volatile petrol and hydrocarbon vapors.
options.C: Steel shovels dissolve immediately when touching diesel.
options.D: Plastic tools absorb fuel faster than absorbent granules.

questions.explanation: Forecourt spill kits strictly use non-sparking plastic spades and hard-bristle brooms because metal scraping on concrete paving creates friction sparks capable of igniting volatile petrol and hydrocarbon vapors.
